description: Topic taxonomy + Speaking question bank + Final Practice presets. Sửa file này rồi npm run build để reflect vào app.

answerFrames: My name is…
my full name is…
self.tip: Tên thường dùng, rồi nói full name.

self.q: How do you spell your name?
self.audioFile: 02 - How do you spell your name.wav
answerFrames: K-H-A-N-H.
Sure, it is spelt K-H-A-N-H.
self.tip: Đọc rõ từng chữ cái, chậm và tách nhau.

answerFrames: I am … years old.
and I was born in…
self.tip: Tuổi + and + năm sinh (sự thật nên dùng and, không cần because).

answerFrames: My birthday is on…
on the … of …
self.tip: on + the + ngày thứ tự + of + tháng.

answerFrames: I come from… / I'm from…
I was born and raised in…
It's in Central Vietnam.
hometown.tip: Nơi + and + vùng miền (sự thật nên dùng and).

hometown.q: What do you like about your hometown?
answerFrames: What I like about my hometown is (that)…
The good thing is…
The people are very friendly, and the food is very delicious.
hometown.tip: Frame + 2 điều thích → câu 2 giải thích từng điều.

hometown.q: What do you dislike about your hometown?
answerFrames: What I don't like about my hometown is (that)…
The trouble is…
The weather isn't very great.

hometown.q: Are there any lakes or rivers in your hometown?
answerFrames: Yes, there is the … River in my hometown.
It is very long and beautiful.
The water is crystal clear.
hometown.tip: Yes + There is + tên sông + câu 2 tả bằng tính từ.

hometown.q: Are there any woods or forests in your hometown?
answerFrames: Yes, there is … National Park near my hometown.
It is big / huge / vast and beautiful.
It has many kinds of plants, and the air there is cool and fresh.
hometown.tip: Yes + There is + tên rừng / công viên + câu 2 tả bằng tính từ.

hometown.q: Are there any hills or mountains in your hometown?
answerFrames: Yes, there is … Mountain in my hometown.
It is high / enormous / rocky and beautiful.
People go hiking / go climbing there.
hometown.tip: Yes + There is + tên núi + câu 2 tả bằng tính từ.

job.q: Are you a student or are you working?
job.audioFile: 07 - Are you a student or are you working.wav
answerFrames: I'm working. I'm a/an… at…
I'm a student at…
job.tip: Chọn working / studying + and + nghề (sự thật, không cần because).

answerFrames: I'm a/an… at…
I'm working as a/an… at…
I develop web applications for businesses.
job.tip: Nghề + at + nơi làm + and + việc chính.

job.q: What is your dream job? Why?
job.audioFile: 08 - What is your dream job - why.wav
answerFrames: My dream is to become a/an… at…
It's a good job for me because…
It's a well-paid job.
job.tip: Dream job + at + nơi làm + because + 1 lý do.

hobbies.q: What do you often do in your free time?
hobbies.audioFile: 09 - What do you often do in your free time.wav
answerFrames: I often + Verb…
I'm really into / keen on…
It helps me stay healthy and reduce stress.

hobbies.q: What do you often do on the weekend?
hobbies.audioFile: 10 - What do you often do at the weekend.wav
answerFrames: At the weekend, I often…
It helps me stay healthy and relax.
I often go out for drinks with my friends.
hobbies.tip: At the weekend + hoạt động + because + lợi ích.

hobbies.q: Do you like sports? How often?
hobbies.audioFile: 11 - Do you like sports - how often.wav
answerFrames: Yes, I play badminton with my friends about once a week.
It helps me stay healthy and relax.
It helps me keep in shape.
hobbies.tip: Yes + môn + tần suất + because + lợi ích.

answerFrames: No, I don't, because I like hanging out with my friends.
We play sports and eat together.
I often spend my free time hanging out with my friends.
hobbies.tip: No, I don't + because + việc thích hơn → câu 2 nói rõ làm gì.

hobbies.q: What kinds of movies do you like?
hobbies.audioFile: 13 - What kinds of films do you like.wav
answerFrames: I don't really watch films.
I like comedy / action / romantic films because…
hobbies.tip: Đây là câu Wh-, KHÔNG trả lời "No, I don't". Nói "I don't really watch films" + because.

answerFrames: I don't have a favourite film.
My favourite film is…
hobbies.tip: Đây là câu Wh-, KHÔNG trả lời "No, I don't". Nói "I don't have a favourite film" + because.

hobbies.audioFile: 16 - Do you like reading books - what do you like reading most.wav
answerFrames: Yes, I like reading books about technology and software development.
I'm really into / interested in reading books about…
They help me improve my knowledge and skills.
hobbies.tip: Yes + chủ đề sách → câu 2 nói lợi ích.

hobbies.q: Do you like listening to music?
hobbies.audioFile: 17 - Do you like listening to music - what kind of music do you often listen to.wav
answerFrames: I often listen to Vietnamese music and remix music.
I usually listen to music when I work or hit the gym.
It helps me relax.
hobbies.tip: Loại nhạc + khi nào nghe + because + lợi ích.

hobbies.audioFile: 18 - Do you like playing computer games - what is your favourite computer game.wav
answerFrames: Yes, but not very often.
My favourite computer game is League of Legends.
We are all working now, so we don't play games very often.
hobbies.tip: Yes, but not very often → tên game → so + lý do ít chơi.

daily-routine.q: What time is it in your country?
daily-routine.audioFile: 19 - What time is it in your country.wav
answerFrames: đúng giờ      → seven o'clock / It's seven
x giờ 30      → half past seven = seven thirty am/pm
x giờ 15      → quarter past seven = seven fifteen am/pm
x giờ 45      → quarter to eight = seven forty-five am/pm
giờ lẻ khác   → eight ten am / six forty-five pm
sáng/chiều    → am / pm  hoặc  in the morning / in the afternoon / at night
daily-routine.tip: seven thirty am — dùng số thẳng + am/pm. Hoặc: half past seven.

daily-routine.q: What time do you get up?
daily-routine.audioFile: 20 - What time do you get up.wav
answerFrames: đúng giờ      → seven o'clock / It's seven
x giờ 30      → half past seven = seven thirty am/pm
x giờ 15      → quarter past seven = seven fifteen am/pm
x giờ 45      → quarter to eight = seven forty-five am/pm
giờ lẻ khác   → eight ten am / six forty-five pm
sáng/chiều    → am / pm  hoặc  in the morning / in the afternoon / at night
daily-routine.tip: seven o'clock — đúng giờ → dùng "o'clock". Hoặc chỉ nói "at seven".

daily-routine.q: What time do you go to work?
answerFrames: đúng giờ      → seven o'clock / It's seven
x giờ 30      → half past seven = seven thirty am/pm
x giờ 15      → quarter past seven = seven fifteen am/pm
x giờ 45      → quarter to eight = seven forty-five am/pm
giờ lẻ khác   → eight ten am / six forty-five pm
sáng/chiều    → am / pm  hoặc  in the morning / in the afternoon / at night
daily-routine.tip: eight o'clock — đúng giờ → dùng "o'clock". Có thể nói "eight am".

daily-routine.q: What time do you have breakfast?
daily-routine.audioFile: 22 - What time do you have breakfast.wav
answerFrames: đúng giờ      → seven o'clock / It's seven
x giờ 30      → half past seven = seven thirty am/pm
x giờ 15      → quarter past seven = seven fifteen am/pm
x giờ 45      → quarter to eight = seven forty-five am/pm
giờ lẻ khác   → eight ten am / six forty-five pm
sáng/chiều    → am / pm  hoặc  in the morning / in the afternoon / at night
daily-routine.tip: seven thirty am = half past seven — 2 cách đọc đều đúng.

daily-routine.q: What time do you have lunch?
answerFrames: đúng giờ      → seven o'clock / It's seven
x giờ 30      → half past seven = seven thirty am/pm
x giờ 15      → quarter past seven = seven fifteen am/pm
x giờ 45      → quarter to eight = seven forty-five am/pm
giờ lẻ khác   → eight ten am / six forty-five pm
sáng/chiều    → am / pm  hoặc  in the morning / in the afternoon / at night
daily-routine.tip: twelve thirty pm = half past twelve — 2 cách đọc đều đúng.

daily-routine.q: What time do you have dinner?
answerFrames: đúng giờ      → seven o'clock / It's seven
x giờ 30      → half past seven = seven thirty am/pm
x giờ 15      → quarter past seven = seven fifteen am/pm
x giờ 45      → quarter to eight = seven forty-five am/pm
giờ lẻ khác   → eight ten am / six forty-five pm
sáng/chiều    → am / pm  hoặc  in the morning / in the afternoon / at night
daily-routine.tip: seven pm — đúng giờ chiều/tối → dùng pm. Hoặc: "at seven in the evening".

daily-routine.q: What time do you come home from work?
answerFrames: đúng giờ      → seven o'clock / It's seven
x giờ 30      → half past seven = seven thirty am/pm
x giờ 15      → quarter past seven = seven fifteen am/pm
x giờ 45      → quarter to eight = seven forty-five am/pm
giờ lẻ khác   → eight ten am / six forty-five pm
sáng/chiều    → am / pm  hoặc  in the morning / in the afternoon / at night
daily-routine.tip: six pm — đúng giờ chiều → dùng pm. Hoặc: "at six in the evening".

daily-routine.q: What time do you go to bed?
daily-routine.audioFile: 26 - What time do you go to bed.wav
answerFrames: đúng giờ      → seven o'clock / It's seven
x giờ 30      → half past seven = seven thirty am/pm
x giờ 15      → quarter past seven = seven fifteen am/pm
x giờ 45      → quarter to eight = seven forty-five am/pm
giờ lẻ khác   → eight ten am / six forty-five pm
sáng/chiều    → am / pm  hoặc  in the morning / in the afternoon / at night
daily-routine.tip: eleven pm — tối muộn → dùng pm hoặc "at night". Không cần "o'clock".

daily-routine.q: How do you go to work?
answerFrames: I go to work by motorbike / bus / bike.
I walk because it is near my house.

daily-routine.q: How often do you phone your friend?
answerFrames: I call my friend once / twice a week.
I often chat with my friends online.
We usually make plans to go out for drinks or play badminton.
daily-routine.tip: Tần suất + because + lý do gọi / chat.

daily-routine.q: How often do you clean the house?
answerFrames: I clean the house every day / once a week.
I always keep things tidy.

daily-routine.q: How often do you read the newspaper?
answerFrames: I never read newspapers.
I rarely read newspapers.

daily-routine.q: How often do you have friends round? (When you have friends round, what do you like to do?)
daily-routine.audioFile: 29 - How often do you have friends round - what do you like to do.wav
answerFrames: When I have friends round, we usually…
We usually play games, drink beer and talk together.
daily-routine.tip: When I have friends round + hoạt động + because.

family.q: Do you live in a big family?
family.audioFile: 30 - Do you live in a big family.wav
answerFrames: No, I live in a small family with my parents and my younger sister.
Yes, I come from quite a big family.
family.tip: Big / small + with + các thành viên.

answerFrames: My father is a/an…
He works as a/an…
He runs a…
family.tip: Nghề + and + chi tiết (sự thật nên dùng and).

answerFrames: My mother is a/an…
She works as a/an…
She works with my father at…
He is really into…
He likes…
It helps him relax.
She is really into…
She likes…
It helps her keep in shape.
family.tip: Nhớ thêm 's': she likes. Rồi + because.

appearance.q: What does your father look like?
answerFrames: He is about fifty.
He is about 169 centimetres tall.
He has got short black hair with some grey hair.
appearance.tip: Age + height + hair, nối bằng and.

appearance.q: What does your mother look like?
answerFrames: She is forty-six years old.
She is about 162 centimetres tall.
She is quite slim.
appearance.tip: Age + height + build. Nữ dùng pretty / good-looking, không dùng handsome.

appearance.q: What kind of hair does your father have?
answerFrames: He has got short black hair.
He has got short black hair with some grey hair.
appearance.tip: Độ dài + màu tóc, dùng "has got".

appearance.q: What kind of hair does your mother have?
answerFrames: She has got long dark brown hair.
long / short / shoulder-length
straight / wavy / curly

appearance.q: What kinds of clothes does your father often wear?
answerFrames: He often wears…
shirts, T-shirts, a pair of jeans, casual clothes
appearance.tip: He often wears + quần áo + because.

appearance.q: What kinds of clothes does your mother often wear?
answerFrames: She often wears…
a dress, office clothes, casual clothes
appearance.tip: She often wears + quần áo + because.

appearance.q: What kinds of clothes are you wearing?
answerFrames: I am wearing…
a shirt, a T-shirt, a pair of jeans, casual clothes
appearance.tip: Câu này dùng Present Continuous: I am wearing… + because.

answerFrames: He is + adjective.
He is kind and responsible.
He is great to be with.
personality.tip: Tính từ + because + 1 ví dụ ngắn.

answerFrames: She is + adjective.
She is patient and caring.
personality.tip: Đừng lẫn với "What does she look like?" (ngoại hình).

personality.q: Is your father friendly, talkative, humorous or generous?
answerFrames: He is really / very + adjective.
He is friendly and easy to talk to.
He loves giving things and doesn't expect anything in return.

personality.q: Is your mother friendly, talkative, humorous or generous?
answerFrames: She is really / very + adjective.
She is friendly and easy to talk to.
personality.tip: Không cần trả lời hết 4 tính từ, chọn 1–2 + because.

house.q: What is your favorite room in your house?
house.audioFile: 38 - What is your favourite room in your house.wav
answerFrames: My favourite room is my bedroom because…
My favourite room is the living room / kitchen.
There is a desk, a bed and a wardrobe.
The desk is between my bed and the wardrobe.
The window is opposite the bed.
house.tip: Phòng thế nào + and + There is / vị trí 1 đồ vật.

house.q: Can you describe your living room?
answerFrames: There is a sofa, a table and a television.
The sofa is opposite the television.
The table is in the middle of the room.
house.tip: Phòng thế nào + and + vị trí (opposite / in the middle).

answerFrames: There is a fridge, a gas cooker and a sink.
The fridge is next to the door.
house.tip: Phòng thế nào + and + There is / are + đồ đạc.

answerFrames: Yes, definitely, because…
No, I don't, because…
relax / learn new things / gain new experience
trip.tip: Yes, definitely + because + 2–3 lý do ngắn.

trip.q: Tell me about one trip you remember the most.
trip.audioFile: 41 - Tell me about one trip you remember the most.wav
answerFrames: 1. Nơi: The trip I remember the most is the trip to…
2. Khi nào: I went there … ago.
3. Đi với ai: I went with my family / friends / girlfriend.
4. Đi bằng gì: We went there by car / train / plane, and it took us about…
5. Làm gì: We did a lot of things there: we went sightseeing, we enjoyed the local food, we went swimming…
6. Cảm nhận: It was great / wonderful / fantastic. I had a terrific time.
trip.tip: Dạng kể — 6 câu ngắn theo đúng thứ tự: nơi → khi nào → với ai → bằng gì → làm gì → cảm nhận.

trip.q: Tell me about one trip you want to take in the future.
trip.audioFile: 42 - Tell me about one trip you want to take in the future.wav
answerFrames: 1. Nơi: I am going to visit…
2. Vì sao: I want to go there because I like its…
3. Đi với ai: I am going to go with…
4. Đi bằng gì: We are going to travel from … to … by train.
5. Ở đâu: We are going to stay at a small cosy hotel near a lake.
6. Làm gì: We are going to walk around the towns, take a lot of photos and try local food.
7. Cảm nhận: I think it will be an amazing experience.
trip.tip: Dạng kể tương lai — dùng "be going to": nơi → vì sao → với ai → bằng gì → ở đâu → làm gì → cảm nhận.

food-restaurant.q: What is your favourite food? Is it good for you?
answerFrames: My favourite food is…
It is healthy because…
I eat a lot of chicken, eggs and vegetables.

food-restaurant.q: What is your favourite drink? Is it good for you?
answerFrames: My favourite drink is…
It is good for me because…
It helps me stay awake.
food-restaurant.tip: Đồ uống + because + tốt / không tốt.

food-restaurant.q: Do you like eating out? How often do you go to a restaurant?
food-restaurant.audioFile: 44 - Do you like eating out - how often do you go to a restaurant.wav
answerFrames: Yes, I do. I go to a restaurant about once a week.
Nhà hàng nào, ở đâu: The restaurant I remember the most is a seafood restaurant in… It was a famous restaurant near my hotel.
Order gì: To start the meal, we had… For the main dishes, we had… For dessert, we had…
Nhận xét: The food was very good and delicious. The staff were friendly, and the service was fast.
Giá + kết: It was very cheap. I would definitely go there again.
food-restaurant.tip: Theo bài mẫu của bạn: Yes + tần suất → nhà hàng nào & ở đâu → order gì → nhận xét → giá & kết.

health-illness.q: Do you have a healthy diet?
answerFrames: Yes, definitely.
I eat a lot of fruits and vegetables.
I drink enough water.

health-illness.q: Do you exercise? What exercise do you do?
answerFrames: Yes, I go to the gym / play badminton.
It helps me keep in shape.
four or five times a week
health-illness.tip: Yes, I do + because + bài tập + tần suất.

answerFrames: Yes, sometimes.
When I feel stressed, I go to the gym.
It helps me relax.

health-illness.q: What should you do if you have a headache?
answerFrames: I often rest and take aspirin.
I often see the doctor.
I stop using the computer.
health-illness.tip: If + triệu chứng, I often + 2 hành động (nối bằng and).

health-illness.q: What should you do if you have a toothache?
answerFrames: I often go to the dentist.
You shouldn't eat sweets.
health-illness.tip: If + toothache, I often go to the dentist + and + 1 ý thêm.

health-illness.q: What should you do if you have got a cold?
answerFrames: I often rest.
I often go to bed with a hot drink.
health-illness.tip: If + have got a cold, I often rest and go to bed with a hot drink.
